title: LandlordGuard Household Credit on a RentGuard Reinstatement Cure
content:
A named insured reinstating a RentGuard Renters Policy who also holds a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy has a landlord household credit taken off the cure.

## Guidance

- When the customer holds a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy in force and at least 2 LandlordGuard premium payments were received in the last 12 calendar months, 4.00 is taken off the cure.
- When the customer holds a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy in force with fewer than 2 LandlordGuard premium payments received in the last 12 calendar months, 2.00 is taken off the cure.
- When the customer holds no LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy in force, no landlord credit applies.

## Points of judgement

- **Holding.** The customer's LandlordGuard policy records are read for a policy whose status is in force. A LandlordGuard policy that is cancelled or expired does not count as held in force.
- **Payments.** The LandlordGuard premium account entries recording a premium payment received are counted when posted within the last 12 calendar months.
- **Threshold.** The count of 2 payments is the dividing line: 2 or more gives 4.00; 0 or 1 gives 2.00, provided the LandlordGuard policy is in force.

| LandlordGuard policy in force | LandlordGuard payments received in the last 12 calendar months | Taken off the cure |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 2 or more | 4.00 |
| yes | 1 | 2.00 |
| yes | 0 | 2.00 |
| no | any | nothing |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A hypothetical customer holding a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy in force whose premium account shows 3 payments received in the last 12 calendar months has 4.00 taken off the cure; had only 1 payment been received in that period, 2.00 would be taken off. A customer whose LandlordGuard policy has been cancelled has no landlord credit on the cure.
